To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Performance evaluation of a software architecture is possible at the early life cycle stages of conceptual design and detailed design.
1. The architecture of a distributed software system is the key to its performance and 2. Performance evaluation techniques for distributed systems are applicable to software architecture evaluation.

the performance of a software architecture is the sum of the performance of its components, the performance of the connections between the components, the performance overhead of the architecture, and the performance overhead of its environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a method for the evaluation of the performance characteristics in early life cycle phases of distributed software architectures.

the following questions. How can we evaluate distributed software architectures in order to determine the performance characteristics? What are the performance characteristics that we should consider? How can we use the performance characteristics to guide the development of a distributed software architecture? How can we measure the performance characteristics of a distributed software system?

the following issues: (1) What are the key performance characteristics of distributed systems that are most relevant to architectural evaluation? (2) What are the techniques that can be used to evaluate these performance characteristics in early life cycle phases?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the architecture of a system is the key to performance and performance evaluation of the architecture is the best way to ensure that the system meets performance requirements.
the performance of a given software architecture can only be assessed with the use of an appropriate performance model.
the techniques described in this paper are useful in assessing distributed software architectures.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is important to consider performance characteristics of distributed systems at an early stage of software development.
the performance of a system architecture is a function of the system architecture and the performance of the components.

we have developed an approach for the performance evaluation of distributed systems architectures that is suitable to use early in the development cycle, and that can be used to identify and correct performance related problems in a distributed system before the system is fully developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the early life cycle stages are a good time to evaluate distributed software architectures.
the evaluation of a distributed system’s architecture should be done early, before the system is implemented, to avoid the problems associated with the late discovery of performance issues.
performance evaluation of distributed systems can be done at the architecture level.
